fact: NITA's eGovernment Interoperability Framework Version 2.0, the update of the 2008 framework, is labelled a draft for stakeholder review; the document gives no printed date, so 2022 is its published date, a proxy from the upload path.
The document states the first Government of Ghana eGIF, with the Government of Ghana Enterprise Architecture, was adopted in 2008.

The document states implementation of the 2008 eGIF was ineffectual and the framework is out of date; it gives no figure of bodies following it, and dates the statement only by its published date of 2022 (proxy).
